answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a distinct certified hardware key instead of a free account. A farm cannot clone a key, so every extra identity needs another physical key bought at retail, a burned fee in outside money, and a separate days-long sequence of unpredictable live challenges signed inside that key. The burned fee doubles for each further key traced to the same funding source, so the tenth fake costs one more key plus 512 times the first fee. What begins as a zephyr of cheap copies soon runs into a canyon of real expense, leaving the attacker's margin at its nadir.
